title: reel-studio project profile
description: Everything reel-studio needs to know about ONE product: where it runs, how to get in, how it looks, and what may never be claimed about it. Lives at <project>/reel-studio.config.json (keep it out of git if sessionJson holds a live cookie).

baseUrl.description: Origin the plates are shot against, e.g. http://localhost:3001. Must be a PRODUCTION build (dev overlays end up in shot). Port must match whatever the app bakes in at build time.

prodStartCommand.description: Shell command that serves the production build on baseUrl, e.g. 'pnpm build && pnpm exec next start --port 3001'. Run by the agent only when healthPath does not answer.

healthPath.description: Path probed (GET, expects 2xx/3xx) before shooting. Used to decide whether prodStartCommand must run.

auth.description: How authenticated plates (dashboards, settings drawers) get a session. The cookie is set first-party on baseUrl before navigation — this is one reason plates exist instead of iframes.

cookieName.description: Session cookie name, e.g. better-auth.session_token. Required when mode = session.

sessionJson.description: Path (relative to the profile) to a JSON file { name, value, handle? } holding a signed session cookie. Mint it from a seeded demo user, never the owner's real session. Required when mode = session.

chromePath.description: Absolute path to a Chrome/Chromium binary for the plate recorder (puppeteer-core). Remotion downloads its own headless shell and ignores this.

name.description: Product name as shown on screen.

domain.description: Bare domain used in CTAs and captions, e.g. example.com. No scheme.

logoPath.description: SVG/PNG logo path, relative to the profile. Copied into the Remotion public/ dir at setup.

fontDisplay.description: @remotion/google-fonts family for headlines, in subpath form, e.g. BricolageGrotesque. Must be a weight the app actually ships.

fontBody.description: @remotion/google-fonts family for captions and chips, e.g. PlusJakartaSans.

accent2.description: Second gradient stop. Defaults to accent.

surface.description: Scene background behind the phone mock.

radius.description: Card/chip corner radius in px at 1080 wide.

neverClaim.description: Claims that must NEVER appear on screen, in captions or in ad copy. Copied verbatim into CAPTIONS.md 'Never say' and checked against every hook/beat before render.

alwaysSay.description: Approved phrasings for sensitive facts (the honest version of each neverClaim). Prefer these over paraphrase.

tiers.description: What each plan actually includes. A reel may only attribute a feature to the tier that ships it.

seed.description: How to populate the LOCAL database so the UI shows something worth filming. Must be idempotent; the agent re-runs it often.

notes.description: Gotchas: encryption keys to preserve across re-seeds, caches to bust, FK rows to wipe first.

outputDir.description: Gitignored directory for plates, renders, covers, sheets and CAPTIONS.md, e.g. NOGIT/reels.

personas.description: Whether fictional people may appear in reels. When allowed, every persona is seeded demo data and is labelled as fictional in CAPTIONS.md — never 'a real user'.

note.description: Constraints: names to reuse from the landing page, identities that must never be shown, avatar source.
